verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own docs confirm read tracking: Mail can 'check which emails have been read', and 'Read statuses' are shared across teams. Independent community discussion corroborates that senders see how many times and from where a recipient opened an email. No first-party doc describes the read-status feature in depth, and the 'when' (open timestamps) part of the story is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of open timestamps ('when' recipients opened), dedicated first-party documentation of the read-status feature for individual senders.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
